title: 現時点のディスクリプション

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Biwa Hayahide and I watch Narita Brian run in a scrimmage, whose incredible performance leaves me in shock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide sees her younger self in my stunned expression. She sees the little girl who was overwhelmed by her sister's speed, panicked, and got hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She barely finishes her story when Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin, her classmates and rivals, join us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're going to compete in the Hopeful Stakes, another junior G1 race. It looks like Narita Brian isn't the only tough competition around.
